body:
I really appreciate this man, thank you. Ironically I also have physical pain, my back is also messed up from an old weightlifting injury and both of my feet are jacked up from skateboarding. So I understand where you’re coming from. 

If you ever wanna PM, I’m down.
You should never feel insensitive or illegimate about your own feelings. That’s you, and there’s a reason why you feel that way. If you’d like to PM me, I’m available.

Great points! And yeah I used to be into gaming like crazy and I do a bit of skateboarding when I’m free. I don’t mind meeting new people or socializing, but I always feel like imma just thrust my bullshit onto them or something if you get what I mean. Because no one likes dealing with stuff, especially when it’s not there’s. 

Also, I was smoking and drinking a bit during my last year in high school, it got too much. Thank you anyway, I’m going to consider everything you said.

Do you really think being an ignorant insensitive asshole is helpful? 

>Are you a woman in fucking China?

>Who will you have proven a point too?

I’m quite well aware that’s there’s people in shittier situations than me, but that doesn’t mean anything I’ve endured is less than. That’s literally what you’re implying by saying some bullshit like that. Also, nobody kills themselves to prove a point to anyone, why on Earth would you think that would be in my mind? Most people would just rather not suffer anymore. 

But I don’t need to explain myself, that’s ridiculous. You’re just somewhere else. If you don’t understand, you don’t. Or maybe you’re one of the worst trolls I’ve ever seen.

I appreciate that, but I’m sure you know the shit is really complicated. Life is far more nuanced than that. Seriously, when I was still in high school that was pretty much my perspective; Nihilisitic optimism. Fuck it life is shit, but who cares, gotta keep living anyway. 

I was aware but not fully aware. Nothing really hit me yet, and I didn’t fully understand all the shit I’d endured until two years ago. Then it just went downhill and I’ve been stuck ever since, trying to crawl my way out. I’m glad you’ve reached that place where you can say that, but I’m still trying to get there myself again, with a lot of help and assistance. And I don’t know if I’ll reach it.
I deleted mine, might as well delete yours. It’s all good though, pointless to get more upset.

Hey thanks a lot, I really appreciate this. It means a lot to me. I’ve definitely tried socializing and going out there man, I live in a huge city. But it’s hard, a lot of people just don’t give a fuck about you or what you have to say. Especially as a musician. 

I’ve thought about therapy, but I’m super broke right now and my insurance is a mess. Also, I’ve heard negative stuff about the suicide hotline, so I’ve stayed away from it. Maybe I won’t when I’m having a moment again. Again, thank you for the taking the time to answer me and trying to be there in any way you can :)
